regDeaths.name: a monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back
a line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark. That is not normal duck behavior.
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log
a shadow moving wrong against the sun
